status: accepted educational E2 D3 implementation; not clinically validated reference

source.authors: Grisendi V, Spada E, Argento C, Plebani M, Milani S, Seracchioli R, Volpe A, La Marca A
source.title: Age-specific reference values for serum FSH and estradiol levels throughout the reproductive period
source.inspection: User-supplied published full PDF, methods p452 and original Table2 p454/PDFpage5; both complete M column and anomalies visually inspected. CSV checked literally against extracted PDF text.
source.statistic: Published modeled age-dependent median P50(M), CG-LMS; not an empirical median for each yearly subgroup, arithmetic mean, laboratory RI or individual longitudinal trajectory.
source.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of numeric [ageYears,p50PgMl] pairs, ascending age, no final newline

numericalVerification.linearCoherence: Source-table coherence was checked in the prior audit only; no fitted trend equation or diagnostic witness coefficients are exported here.

excludedSourceCells.age18M: Excluded due to printed P50 inconsistency; no substitution or interpolation through age18.
excludedSourceCells.otherCentilesAndParameters: Do not import P5/P25/P75/P95, L, S, SDS or RI. P5 at19/20 has separate anomalies that do not invalidate the selected M cells.

population.design: Single-center cross-sectional selected clinical cohort, University of Modena, Italy; not a representative random population sample or independently validated fertility cohort.
exclusionsReported: Sex hormone administration in the previous 6 months
Previous pelvic inflammatory disease or ovarian surgery
Known chronic systemic, metabolic or endocrine disease including hyperandrogenism
population.notEstablished: Individual ovulation confirmation, detailed pregnancy/lactation screening, sample counts per age, ethnic distribution and general assay transferability were not reported.
population.unknownHistoryPolicy: Missing information does not establish absence of study exclusions. Do not reconstruct an obligatory full research eligibility questionnaire.

samplingAndAssay.sensitivityTerminology: Reported sensitivity only; formal LOD/LOQ definitions, derivation and reagent version were not provided.
samplingAndAssay.sampleHandling: Centrifugation at 2000 g for 10 minutes; serum stored at −80°C.
samplingAndAssay.sourceCensoring: Counts and handling of measurements below sensitivity/LOD/LOQ, imputation or exclusion were not reported. Do not infer no censoring.
samplingAndAssay.patientMethodPolicy: Source assay does not establish the patient specimen or method; no proven equivalence to LC-MS/MS or every modern immunoassay.

authorization.decision: Owner accepted the private desktop/mobile E2 D3 mockup and instructed implementation: jest ok, koduj.
authorization.scope: Selected literal P50 ages19–44; separate optional current-E2 D3 educational block only. No new laboratory RI, SDS, percentile, ovarian-reserve interpretation or historical reassessment.

ageDomain.endpointRule: Exact44 is eligible. [44,45) is not. [43,44) is eligible. No extrapolation or terminal plateau after44. Age18 and intervals extending below19 are excluded.
ageDomain.ageMeaning: Published table knots, not proof that numerical recruitment/observed extrema equal these endpoints; source inclusion16–45 and discussion<45 differ from table16–44.

referenceAtEnteredAge.exactIntegerAge: Return literal published M at its knot.
referenceAtEnteredAge.fractionalAge: Linear interpolation only between adjacent selected literal M nodes inside[19,44], labeled interpolated; application policy, not a recovered author equation.
referenceAtEnteredAge.uncertainAge: Display for entered lower boundary only after the complete age interval qualifies; do not invent date of birth or choose interval midpoint.

acceptedApplicationPolicy.defaultState: Display clearly named source median for qualifying age without requiring day3; do not draw a patient point or imply matched sampling.

sampleDayAnswer.scope: Current E2 result for the same person only
sampleDayAnswer.promptPl: Czy ten wynik E2 pochodzi z 3. dnia cyklu?
sampleDayAnswer.sameDrawRule: A shared D3 fact requires explicit confirmation of same person and same blood draw. Merely switching FSH→E2 does not confirm this; for this block clear the local D3 answer on analyte/result/person/context change.

acceptedApplicationPolicy.patientPoint: Optional educational juxtaposition only after explicit D3 confirmation for the current E2 result, a qualifying whole age interval, an exact numerical result and otherwise compatible current context. No ratio, SDS, centile position, laboratory verdict or ovarian-reserve diagnosis.
acceptedApplicationPolicy.phaseRule: Known follicular or unknown broad phase cannot itself prove D3. Explicit D3 with known ovulation/luteal phase is conflicting; no patient point and do not silently change the phase.
acceptedApplicationPolicy.knownIncompatibilities: Known pregnancy, menopause, hormonal treatment/GnRHa, stimulation, incompatible specimen/method or unavailable/historical context withhold this block; these are conservative application gates, not all literal paper exclusions.
acceptedApplicationPolicy.unknownMethodOrHistory: Unknown remains unknown. It may allow limited source information under the accepted educational contract; it never confirms assay match or negative history.

censoredPatientResults.inequalities: Preserve<,>,≤,≥ and laboratory threshold with proper unit conversion; do not turn threshold into exact concentration or plot a precise patient point.
censoredPatientResults.symbolicLodLoq: Preserve<LOD/<LOQ with unknown numerical boundary; do not substitute historical assay sensitivity10pg/mL.
censoredPatientResults.imputation: Never replace with0, half threshold, threshold or10pg/mL.

presentation.referenceLabelPl: Opublikowana mediana E2 dla wpisanego wieku (dzień 3)
presentation.statisticExplanationPl: Mediana modelu wieku z badania Grisendi2014; nie jest zakresem referencyjnym ani oceną rezerwy jajnikowej.
presentation.noDay3MessagePl: Nie potwierdzono 3. dnia cyklu dla tego wyniku E2 — pokazujemy wyłącznie dane badania.
presentation.censoredMessagePl: Dokładne stężenie nie jest znane; wynik zachowuje znak nierówności.

acceptedApplicationPolicy.history: No proposal to persist day3 answer or new E2 reference in lab.hormoneReference, pinned assessment or historical schema. No reassessment of saved results with current age/context.
acceptedApplicationPolicy.preserveExisting: Existing E2 phase information, laboratory ranges/result conversion and lifespan educational geometry remain separate contracts.

measurementUnitPolicy.basis: All five units already supported by the production E2 converter; no new conversion coefficient.
measurementUnitPolicy.inequalities: Apply the same positive scaling to a numerical limit, retaining the operator. Symbolic LOD/LOQ remain unquantified.

verificationStatus: Source audit complete; production-function, browser, PWA and final-SHA GitHub validation are reported by the integrating PR, not asserted here.
